// TEST ONLY. This entry point is never referenced by application configuration.
import worker from "__PI_FLOW_BUILT_WORKER__";

const pending = [];
let lastBatch = [];
const queue = {
  async send(body) {
    pending.push(structuredClone(body));
  },
  async sendBatch(messages) {
    for (const message of messages) await this.send(message.body);
  },
};

function eventLifecycle(ctx) {
  const work = [];
  return {
    context: {
      waitUntil(promise) {
        work.push(Promise.resolve(promise));
        ctx.waitUntil(promise);
      },
      passThroughOnException() { ctx.passThroughOnException(); },
    },
    async complete() {
      // A task may register more work while settling. Drain to quiescence.
      for (let offset = 0; offset < work.length;) {
        const batch = work.slice(offset);
        offset = work.length;
        await Promise.all(batch);
      }
    },
  };
}

export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    if (
      env.APP_ENV !== "local" ||
      env.PI_FLOW_TEST_ONLY !== "TEST DATA - NEVER DEPLOY" ||
      !["127.0.0.1", "localhost"].includes(url.hostname)
    )
      return new Response("Test fixture is loopback-only", { status: 403 });
    const bindings = { ...env, ASYNC_JOBS: queue };
    const lifecycle = eventLifecycle(ctx);
    if (url.pathname === "/__test/pi/scheduled" && request.method === "POST") {
      if (request.headers.get("origin") !== url.origin)
        return new Response("Origin required", { status: 403 });
      await worker.scheduled(
        { cron: "* * * * *", scheduledTime: Date.now(), noRetry() {} },
        bindings,
        lifecycle.context,
      );
      await lifecycle.complete();
      return Response.json({ scheduled: true, pending: pending.length });
    }
    if (url.pathname === "/__test/pi/queue" && request.method === "POST") {
      if (request.headers.get("origin") !== url.origin)
        return new Response("Origin required", { status: 403 });
      const bodies = url.searchParams.has("replay")
        ? structuredClone(lastBatch)
        : pending.splice(0);
      if (!url.searchParams.has("replay")) lastBatch = structuredClone(bodies);
      let acknowledged = 0;
      let retries = 0;
      await worker.queue(
        {
          queue: "pi-flow-test-stub",
          messages: bodies.map((body) => ({
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),
            timestamp: new Date(),
            attempts: 1,
            body,
            ack() {
              acknowledged++;
            },
            retry() {
              retries++;
              pending.push(body);
            },
          })),
          ackAll() {
            acknowledged = bodies.length;
          },
          retryAll() {
            retries = bodies.length;
            pending.push(...bodies);
          },
        },
        bindings,
        lifecycle.context,
      );
      await lifecycle.complete();
      return Response.json({ delivered: bodies.length, acknowledged, retries });
    }
    const response = await worker.fetch(request, bindings, lifecycle.context);
    await lifecycle.complete();
    return response;
  },
};
